headline: One set of revenue numbers that Sales, Marketing, CS, Product, and Finance all forecast from.
pitch: I build the revenue data foundation a go-to-market team runs on, and then I use it. At flyExclusive I report to the Chief Commercial Officer and own HubSpot Enterprise architecture and governance, the attribution and funnel dashboards leadership reviews, and an LLM pipeline that has enriched about 500,000 CRM records and scores leads (personalized outreach gets a 150% better response rate). At the start of H2 2026 I re-forecast sales for the rest of the year, and actuals have tracked much closer to my numbers than to the original plan. Since May 2026 I've also been interim manager of the retail sales team, about 20 reps doing roughly $10M a month. Before that, at TRANZACT, I partnered with commercial and finance leadership on attribution, forecasting, and testing. I'm based in Raleigh, in the Eastern time zone, and I lived and worked in India for two years and speak conversational Hindi, so the travel to your team there is a plus for me.

requirements.need: Build integrated data models, shared metric definitions, reporting, and full-funnel forecasts
requirements.evidence: At flyExclusive I designed the CRM data architecture that reporting, attribution, and lead scoring all read from: about 300 contact properties consolidated to 100 governed sources of truth, lifecycle stages, deduplication, and Master Data Management. I run the ETL and daily jobs on Azure (Databricks at TRANZACT). In H2 2026 I re-forecast sales in the financial plan, and actuals have tracked much closer to my revision than to the original plan. On this site, one channel definition is enforced in code and every view reads from it.

requirements.need: Data models and BI capabilities across multiple functions, including beyond Sales
requirements.evidence: My work serves marketing, sales, finance, and leadership: funnel and attribution dashboards, and conversational reporting that the entire executive leadership team and sales team use for on-demand answers. At TRANZACT I synced behavioral data into Iterable for 10+ lifecycle campaigns, forecast with finance, and delivered analytics to partner insurance carriers. I replaced Tableau and Airtable with tools I built myself.

requirements.need: Lead revenue intelligence and funnel strategy across acquisition, expansion, renewal, and retention
requirements.evidence: I built attribution frameworks at flyExclusive connecting marketing activity to acquisition, retention, and high-value segments, and I manage ~$300K a month in digital ad spend through our agency. As interim manager of the ~20-person retail sales team I use that funnel daily, and I run decision analytics on contract concessions. Expansion and renewal motions in a SaaS business would be new territory for me.

requirements.need: Develop stage-specific ideal customer profiles and turn insights into growth strategy
requirements.evidence: I built lead routing (product leads to the reps most experienced selling them, round robin for the rest) and an LLM-powered lead-scoring model that prioritizes high-value accounts; personalized outreach from it gets a 150% better response rate. At TRANZACT I ran segmentation and an A/B testing program (50% win rate, 30% CTR improvement).

requirements.need: Measure revenue initiatives and report performance, forecasts, and insights to executives
requirements.evidence: I present build priorities to flyExclusive's Chief Commercial Officer monthly and run the leadership dashboards and the sales team's numbers. When sales leadership wanted to email the biggest list possible despite a "Bad" domain reputation, I made the data case for engaged, opted-in contacts only, and open rates doubled. At TRANZACT I translated commercial data into executive recommendations. I haven't presented at the board level yet.

requirements.need: Turn data and competitive intelligence into positioning, messaging, and enablement content
requirements.evidence: I shipped a Python competitive-pricing app for flyExclusive's retail sales team that directly informed the 2026 pricing tables and strategy. I built AI proposal and agreement tools that put approved messaging in every rep's hands and save 1 to 2 hours per lead, and I run biweekly office hours to train the sales team.

requirements.need: Experience with revenue operations systems (Salesforce, CPQ, Gong, Dialpad AI)
requirements.evidence: Deep in HubSpot Enterprise (every hub), plus Marketo, Iterable, a CDP, BigQuery, Stripe Billing, and a Plaid integration I'm building now. I'm leading flyExclusive's move from HubSpot to an in-house tool. I haven't run Salesforce, CPQ, Gong, or Dialpad in production; the data modeling transfers, and I'd ramp on Azuga's Salesforce objects and Gong call data first.

requirements.need: Coordinate cross-functional initiatives, timelines, and handoffs
requirements.evidence: Led flyExclusive's website migration, HubSpot transformation, and Tableau and Airtable replacements across marketing, sales, and leadership while managing the sales team. Every build starts with a PRD and sign-off, and I run the work in Microsoft Planner with named reviewers and deadlines. I own a ~$500K-a-year marketing tools budget.

requirements.need: Up to 20% travel to India, Tennessee, and customer locations
requirements.evidence: Glad to travel. I lived and worked in India from 2018 to 2020, working day to day alongside local colleagues, and I speak conversational Hindi, so I'm comfortable working in person with Azuga's team there and across time zones.

requirements.need: 10+ years in revenue intelligence, BI, analytics, RevOps, or growth strategy; scaling a SaaS business with $50M+ ARR
requirements.evidence: Six years across marketing, CRM analytics, and revenue systems, most recently at fast-growing flyExclusive, and before that at TRANZACT. My experience is in private aviation and direct-to-consumer insurance, not SaaS, and short of the ten years asked for. What I'd bring instead is hands-on building: I write the SQL, Python, and AI pipelines myself.

featured.title: UTM Journey Tracker — live
